mission: Cross-page visual concept map: .squad/SQ-058/concept-dedup.md — which of the ~10 pages' planned concepts overlap, which existing site assets (115 files under static/images/articles/) are reusable for this tier, and the shared-vs-distinct ruling per concept.
context:
Three lieutenants author per-page plans in parallel; you map the OVERLAPS so the Commander can dedup before Codex generates.
1. CONCEPT MATRIX: list the ~15-20 likely figure concepts across the 10 pages (meter dial reading, bill anatomy, TOU clock, tier ladder, deposit lifecycle, leak-check flow, disconnection timeline, demand-vs-energy, dye test, CCF conversion...). For each: which pages want it, is ONE shared asset right (same file referenced from multiple pages) or must each page get its own (context differs)? Ruling + reason. Rule of thumb: share when the figure is context-identical; split when labels/numbers must match that page's worked example.
2. EXISTING-ASSET REUSE: inventory static/images/articles/ (ls -R, 115 files, ~35 slug dirs). For concepts in the matrix, check whether a sibling page already has a suitable asset (e.g. meter dials on how-to-read-electric-meter vs water-meter's dial-meter-reading.webp; bill anatomy variants on 01/electric-bill-breakdown/21-past-due's unwired past-due-bill-anatomy.webp; TOU clock on 08-TOU). Do NOT read_image (text-only seat) — judge by filename + the source page's wiring context (grep the src + alt of existing wirings).
3. NAMING: propose the canonical filename for each NEW shared asset (avoid per-slug duplication when shared).
4. GENERATION COUNT: estimate the distinct NEW images Codex must generate after reuse (target the smallest honest set).
known_facts: Unwired-on-disk assets in this tier: 21-past-due's past-due-bill-anatomy.webp + past-due-disconnection-timeline.webp.
08-TOU time-of-use-clock.webp and water-meter dial-meter-reading.webp are already wired in body.
Product images live separately under static/images/products/ (12 ASIN -> 9 files, complete) — out of your scope.
constraints: Rulings must state the reason; no bare lists.
success_criteria: Concept matrix with shared/split ruling per concept
Reuse table (existing asset -> pages that can wire it)
